## Problem

What user or engineering problem does this change address?

## Changes

Describe the resulting behavior and relevant design decisions.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their outcomes. Include screenshots for implemented UI changes, where useful.

## Limitations and follow-up

Identify mock behavior, migrations, integration prerequisites and unresolved risks relevant to this change.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and documentation matches the actual implementation.
- [ ] Authorization and state changes are covered where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets or personal candidate data are included.
